text:
Type: clear glass jar vase
Use: holding cut flowers, branches or decorative fillers on a dining table, sideboard or shelf; dining room, living room
Style: Scandinavian, minimalist, farmhouse
Materials: clear transparent glass, thick rolled rim, heavy flat base
Colors: clear, colorless transparent
Shape: wide cylindrical body with rounded shoulders narrowing to a short neck and a rolled lip, like an oversized storage jar, sturdy and medium sized
Feel: fresh, simple, airy, light
Goes with: green stems, white flowers, light wood, linen; Scandinavian, farmhouse or minimalist rooms

product.description: The glass vase is mouth blown by a skilled craftsperson.
